One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! STICKY CAJUN HONEY CHICKEN WITH AVOCADO CREMA & CHARRED CORN SALAD Cook once, eat twice. One of my favourite ways to make eating well a little easier. This is the perfect dinner that doubles up as an even better lunch the next day, no reheating needed. Sticky Cajun honey chicken, a crunchy charred corn salad & the most delicious avocado crema.  Serves 4 at 450kcal & 40g protein per serving 450g chicken mini breast fillets or breast cut into strips 1 tbsp Greek yoghurt 1 tbsp Cajun spice blend 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 tsp honey Avocado crema 1 medium ripe avocado 100g Greek yoghurt 2 tbsp pickled jalapeños + 2 tbsp brine 1 tsp honey 1 spring onion 1 small garlic clove Handful of fresh coriander 50g feta Corn salad 2 corn cobs (or 200g frozen sweetcorn) ½ cucumber, deseeded and diced 1 small red onion, finely diced 80g feta, crumbled 1 tin chickpeas, drained and rinsed (I love Bold Bean Co.) Fresh coriander  1 lime Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, Cajun spices, garlic and honey until well coated. Leave to marinate while you prepare everything else. For the avocado crema, add the avocado, yoghurt, jalapeños, brine, honey, spring onion, garlic, coriander and feta to a blender. Whizz until completely smooth and creamy, adding a splash of water if needed. Season to taste. Heat a large frying pan over a high heat and add the corn with a little olive oil. Leave undisturbed for a few minutes to get those lovely charred edges, then toss and cook until golden. Leave to cool slightly before mixing with the cucumber, red onion, chickpeas, crumbled feta and some chopped corriander. Cook the marinated chicken over a medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes, turning until golden, sticky and cooked all the way through. Spread a generous spoonful of avocado crema across the base of a bowl, pile on the charred corn salad and finish with the sticky Cajun chicken. Serve with a good squeeze of fresh lime. For lunch the next day, simply box up the leftover chicken and salad with a dollop of avocado crema, keeping it separate if possible. Refrigerate promptly and enjoy cold the next day. I didn't really measure anything, so just measure with your heart! <3 Chicken: - Chicken breast - Salsa - Chicken bone broth - Red onion - Fajita seasoning - Smoked paprika - Garlic powder or fresh garlic - Onion powder - Chicken bouillon - Salt & pepper - Drizzle of honey (optional)  - Fresh lime juice - Cilantro Potatoes & veggies: - Red potatoes - Bell peppers - Red onion - Oil - Fajita seasoning - Garlic powder & onion powder - Smoked paprika - Chili powder (for the potatoes) - Salt & pepper 1. Add chicken, salsa, broth, onion, a drizzle of oil, and seasonings to your crockpot. Cook on HIGH for 2–4 hours or until the chicken reaches 165 F and shreds easily. Mine only took about 2 hours since my chicken breasts were pretty thin! 2. Shred the chicken and mix it back into the juices. Finish with fresh lime juice and cilantro! 3. Dice your potatoes, toss with oil and seasonings, and roast at 425 F for 30–40 minutes, tossing halfway through. 4. Toss your peppers and onions with oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 425 F for 18–25 minutes. I broiled mine for a couple minutes at the end to get some charred edges! 5. Assemble your bowls with potatoes, chicken, peppers, and onions! I like to add some Greek yogurt instead of sour cream, fresh avocado, and a good jalapeño salsa when I'm ready to eat! Makes about 4 bowls! Store in the fridge for 3–4 days. #fyp #recipes #foryoupage #mealprep #explorepage✨
